Fields.Name: Variable Bindings
Fields.Description: The bindings that drive this object's fields from behavior variables or character properties each frame.

Fields.Name: User Data
Fields.Description: A value for the game's own use; Havok doesn't read it.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The node's name. Used to find it in the outline and in the action scripts; it doesn't have to be unique.

Fields.Name: Enable
Fields.Description: Whether the modifier runs. A disabled modifier leaves the pose it's given unchanged.

Fields.Name: Modifier ID
Fields.Description: The ID the game uses to turn this look-at on and off and set its target.

Fields.Name: Rotation Axis Type
Fields.Description: The order the two rotation axes are applied in: X then Y, or Y then X.

Fields.Name: Sensing Dummy Poly
Fields.Description: The dummy poly (model point) the look-at senses its target from, such as the head.

Fields.Name: Twist Params
Fields.Description: The bone chains turned towards the target, each with its own rates.

Fields.Name: Up Limit Angle
Fields.Description: How far up the chain can turn, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Down Limit Angle
Fields.Description: How far down the chain can turn, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Right Limit Angle
Fields.Description: How far right the chain can turn, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Left Limit Angle
Fields.Description: How far left the chain can turn, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Up Minimum Angle
Fields.Description: The smallest upward turn, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Down Minimum Angle
Fields.Description: The smallest downward turn, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Right Minimum Angle
Fields.Description: The smallest turn to the right, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Left Minimum Angle
Fields.Description: The smallest turn to the left, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Sensing Angle
Fields.Description: The cone the target must be in to be looked at, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Set Angle Method
Fields.Description: How the turn is spread over each chain: evenly (linear) or growing towards the end (ramped).

Fields.Name: Is Additive
Fields.Description: Whether the turn is added to the pose's rotation, rather than replacing it.
